mentions.name: Canaan Online web client remake
mentions.description: A remake of the old MMORPG Canaan Online as a fully native web client, with a somewhat playable server and client already working. The work involves reverse engineering the client-server protocol, network programming, and rendering nostalgic 2D sprites with WebGL.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm remaking an old MMORPG Canaan Online to be fully native web client, learn a lot like reverse engineering the client server protocol, a bit of network programming, and how to render that sweet nostalgic 2D sprite with WebGL. Currently had somewhat playable server and the client going, got lot of help from AI to learn the domain I quite not understand.
mentions.author: adakbar
